cause: The default 5-second assertion expires while cold cross-language indexes are still being processed in the Worker after the local empty result is already shown. The correct zh-Hans help response and URL arrive later in the same page without retry.
minimalFix: Use toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 }) for this cross-language help assertion, matching both shared search checks and the existing French interaction check.
limitations: No product performance optimization claimed; this isolates assertion synchronization against the existing async help contract.
Network transfer and Worker reply timing localize the delay after download; the probe does not separately profile JSON deserialization versus MiniSearch loading.
Original archived matrix failure has no Worker trace; the unchanged artifact independently reproduces the identical symptom naturally.
